notes: Only 14 usable dates exist (materiality tracking started 2026-07-24) -- too few for a real train/val split, reported as one pooled result. This tests materiality as a bucket-based SELECTION rule instead, using real staircase-stop-simulated outcomes already computed by sentiment_outcome_tracker.py -- no new data collection needed.
